_comment: Idea #24 P1 — what the in-game editor's marker system exports. `annotations` are ADVISORY coordinate anchors: build creates no records from them; a human or AI agent reads label+kind+position to author the real spec sections in the next round (e.g. 'place a goat at marker goat', 'raise the terrain at hill-top'). Coordinates follow the placement contract: interior = cell + cell-local, exterior = worldspace + world-space; angles in degrees.
